description: Crawl one site in one paid call: start URL + max_pages (2-20); we follow same-host links breadth-first, returning each page as clean markdown (same extraction as /web/contents). Priced at $0.002 per requested page, quoted as max_pages up front — finding fewer pages is still a complete delivery. Failed pages are skipped and listed in skipped[]; the call still settles. Only an unreadable start page is a 400, no charge. USDC on Base, no account, no API key.

max_chars_per_page.description: Maximum content length per page in characters (1000-20000, default 5000); longer pages are cut and flagged truncated

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to crawl, breadth-first over same-host links (2-20, default 5). Priced at $0.001 per requested page; finding fewer pages is still a complete delivery.

url.description: The http(s) start URL of the site to crawl. Literal IP addresses, localhost and non-http(s) schemes are rejected.

name: web_crawl
